group.title: Training room booking
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — CEDAR MEETING CENTRE: ROOM GUIDE
All room rates cover one half-day, up to four hours. Wireless internet, a projector, and drinking water are included. Catering is charged separately. Rooms can be rearranged on request, except the fixed-seat Auditorium.

Willow: capacity 12; $160; ground floor; movable tables.
Birch: capacity 24; $240; first floor; movable tables.
Maple: capacity 36; $310; ground floor; movable tables.
Auditorium: capacity 60; $380; first floor; fixed theatre seating.

Ground-floor rooms have direct step-free access from the car park. The lift to the first floor will be out of service from April 8 through April 12. Reservations may be cancelled without charge until seven calendar days before the event. Later cancellation incurs the full room fee.

DOCUMENT 2 — EMAIL
To: Cedar Meeting Centre
From: Alex Moreno, Solis Training
Date: March 27
Subject: April 10 workshop

Please reserve a room for 20 participants from 9 a.m. to noon on April 10. We need to arrange tables into four small discussion groups. One participant uses a wheelchair, so step-free access is essential. Please choose the lowest-priced room that meets these requirements. We will bring our own refreshments and do not need catering. Could you confirm whether a projector is included? Our facilitator will arrive thirty minutes early; please let me know if that would affect the price.
group.passageZh:
文件一：Cedar 會議中心教室指南
費用以半日計，最多四小時，含無線網路、投影機及飲水。餐飲另計。除固定座位的禮堂外，可依需求重新配置。
Willow：十二人，$160，地面層，桌子可移動。
Birch：二十四人，$240，地面層的上一層，桌子可移動。
Maple：三十六人，$310，地面層，桌子可移動。
Auditorium：六十人，$380，地面層的上一層，固定式劇院座椅。
地面層的教室可從停車場直接進入，沿途沒有階梯。通往上一層的電梯自四月八日至十二日停用。至少提前七個日曆日取消預訂不收費；不足七天則收取全額場地費。

文件二：電子郵件
收件者：Cedar 會議中心
寄件者：Solis Training 的 Alex Moreno
日期：三月二十七日
主旨：四月十日工作坊
請預訂四月十日上午九點至中午十二點供二十人使用的教室。我們需將桌子分成四組討論。有一名參加者使用輪椅，無階梯動線不可少。請選符合條件的最低價教室。我們自備茶點，不需餐飲。請確認是否含投影機。帶領人員會提前三十分鐘到場，請告知是否影響價格。
